content: U mɑɑ nɛɛ, tɔnun bii, ɑ tire teni temwɔ kpɑ ɑ dɑ ɑ kɑ Isirelibɑ ɡɑri ko.
Ye u nɔɔ wukiɑ, yerɑ Gusunɔ u tire te kpɛ̃ɛ mi, u derɑ u tu temɑ.
Mɑ u nɛɛ, tɔnun bii, ɑ wunɛn nukuru yibio kpɑ ɑ wunɛn wɑsi diisiɑ kɑ tire te nɑ nun wɛ̃ mi. Ye u tire te temɑ, mɑ tɑ nùn dore nɡe tim.
Yerɑ u mɑɑ nɛɛ, Esekiɛli, ɑ seewo ɑ dɑ Isirelibɑn mi kpɑ ɑ bu nɛn ɡɑri sɔ̃.
N ǹ mɔ nɑ nun ɡɔriɔ bwese tuku dɑbinun mi, nìn bɑrum mu nɔɔbu sɛ̃, ɑ ǹ mɑɑ kpɛ̃ ɑ ben ɡɑri tubu. Adɑmɑ Isirelibɑn miyɑ nɑ nun ɡɔriɔ. Nɑ̀ n dɑɑ nun ɡɔrɑ bwese tuku nin mi, nu koo nun swɑɑ dɑki,
ɑdɑmɑ wee, Isirelibɑ bɑ ǹ nun swɑɑ dɑkimɔ. Domi bɑ ǹ kĩ bu nɛn ɡere nɔ yèn sɔ̃ be kpuro bɑ swɑɑ tɑu mɑ ben ɡɔ̃ru ɡɑ bɔɔbu.
Yen sɔ̃, kon mɑɑ wunɛn tii bɔbiɑsiɑ kpɑ ɑ swɑɑ tɑɑyɑ nɡe be,
ɑ n ɡɔ̃ru bɔ nɡe kperu. A ku bɛrum ko ben swɑɑ tɑɑ bin sɔ̃. Domi bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ bwese te tɑ ku rɑ mɛm nɔ.
Mɑ u mɑɑ kpɑm nɛɛ, Esekiɛli, ɑ swɑɑ dɑkio ɑ nɔ kpɑ ɑ ɡɑri yi kon nun sɔ̃ nɛnɛ wunɛn ɡɔ̃ruɔ.
Yen biru, kpɑ ɑ dɑ ɑ wunɛn mɛro bisibu deemɑ mi bɑ yoru dimɔ. Bɑ nun swɑɑ dɑki? Bɑ ǹ nun swɑɑ dɑki? A ɡesi bu sɔ̃ɔwɔ mɑ nɛnɑ nɑ kɑ bu ɡɑri mɔ̀.
Yerɑ Gusunɔn Hunde u Esekiɛli suɑ mɑ u nɔɔɡiru nuɑ win biruɔ tɑ ɡerumɔ kɑ dɑm tɑ mɔ̀, bu Yinni Gusunɔ siɑro mi u wɑ̃ɑ u win yiiko bɑkɑ sɔ̃ɔsimɔ.
Mɑ u hunde koni ben kɑsɑn wɔkinu nɔɔmɔ yɑ soonɑmɔ kɑ sere mɑɑ ben uruubɑn wɔkinu. Wɔki ni, nu kpɛ̃ɑ n bɑndɑ.
Gusunɔn Hunde wi u nùn suɑ mi, u kɑ nùn doonɑ, mɑ win dɑm nùn nɛnuɑ. Mɑ Esekiɛlin mɔru seewɑ u burisinɑ.
U turɑ Tɛli Abibuɔ, Kebɑrin dɑɑrun bɔkuɔ mi yoo be, bɑ wɑ̃ɑ. Mɑ u sinɑ kɑ biti bɑkɑ ben suunu sɔɔ sɔ̃ɔ nɔɔbɑ yiru.
Esekiɛli koo Isirelibɑ kirɔ ko
Sɔ̃ɔ nɔɔbɑ yiru yen biru, Yinni Gusunɔ u Esekiɛli sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ,
wunɛ tɔnun bii, kon de ɑ Isirelibɑ nɔni doke. Kɑɑ n dɑ nɛn ɡɑri swɑɑ dɑki kpɑ ɑ kɑ bu kirɔ ko.
Nɛ, Yinni Gusunɔ, nɑ̀ n tɛ̃ nɛɛ, tɔn kɔ̃so ɡoo u koo ɡbi, mɑ ɑ ǹ nùn kirɔ kue u win dɑɑ kɔ̃sɑ ye deri u kɑ win wɑ̃ɑru wɔrɑ, tɔn kɔ̃so wi, u koo ɡbiwɑ win dɑɑ yen sɔ̃. Wunɑ kon mɑɑ win yɛm bikiɑ.
Adɑmɑ ɑ̀ n nùn kirɔ kuɑ, mɑ u ǹ win dɑɑ kɔ̃sɑ ye deri, u koo ɡbiwɑ win dɑɑ kɔ̃sɑ yen sɔ̃ kpɑ wunɛ ɑ wunɛn wɑ̃ɑru wɔrɑ.
Gemɡii ù n ɡem deri u kɔ̃sɑ kuɑ mɑ ɑ ǹ nùn kirɔ kue, mɑ nɑ nùn yinɑ bɛriɑ, u koo ɡbiwɑ kɔ̃sɑ yen sɔ̃. Nɑ ǹ win yellun dɑɑ ɡeɑ ɡɑrisimɔ, ɑdɑmɑ wunɑ kon win yɛm bikiɑ.
À n mɑɑ nùn kirɔ kuɑ u ku kɑ durum ko, mɑ u ǹ durum ye kue, u ǹ ɡbimɔ. Wunɛn tii ɑ mɑɑ wunɛn wɑ̃ɑru wɔrɑwɑ mi, domi ɑ nùn kirɔ kuɑ.
Esekiɛli
kun mɑɑ kpɛ̃ u ɡɑri ko
Yinni Gusunɔn dɑm mu Esekiɛli yɔɔwɑ mɑ u nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, ɑ seewo ɑ dɑ wɔwɑɔ. Miyɑ kon nun ɡɑri sɔ̃.
Mɑ u seewɑ u dɑ wɔwɑ mi. Mɑ u Gusunɔn yiikon ɡirimɑ wɑ nɡe sɑnɑm mɛ u rɑɑ wɑ̃ɑ Kebɑrin dɑɑrun bɔku mi. Mɑ u yiirɑ kɑ dɑm u siriru tem ɡirɑri.
Yerɑ Gusunɔn Hunde u mɑɑ nùn yɔɔwɑ. Mɑ u nùn seeyɑ u yɔ̃rɑsiɑ. Sɑɑ ye sɔɔrɑ Yinni Gusunɔ u nɛɛ, ɑ doo ɑ tii kɛnusi wunɛn dirɔ.
Mɛyɑ bɑ koo nun bɔke kpɑ ɑ kpɑnɑ ɑ yɑri tɔɔwɔ, tɔmbu bu nun wɑ.
Kon de wunɛn yɑrɑ yu wunɛn dɑro mɑni kpɑ ɑ kpɑnɑ ɑ ɡɑri ko. Mɛyɑ ɑ ǹ kɑɑ kpĩ ɑ mɑɑ bu ɡerusi be, be bɑ ku rɑ mɛm nɔ mi.

Adɑmɑ nɑ̀ n kɑ nun ɡɑri kuɑ, kon wunɛn nɔɔ wukiɑ. Sɑɑ ye sɔɔrɑ kɑɑ tɔn be sɔ̃ ɑ nɛɛ, ɑmɛniwɑ nɛ, Yinni Gusunɔ nɑ ɡeruɑ. Adɑmɑ ben ɡɑbɑ bɑ koo nun swɑɑ dɑki, ɡɑbɑ kun mɑɑ nun swɑɑ dɑkimɔ. Domi bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ bwese te tɑ ku rɑ mɛm nɔ.
Gusunɔn sɔmɔ u nɛɛ,
bɑ koo Yerusɑlɛmu tɑrusi
